resources.string: Larger sizes fit more keys, so each key is smaller. They want a wider screen.

With Fn: the top row does what is printed on it (brightness, media, volume) and Fn plus a key sends F1 to F12. On 65%% and 60%%, which have no F row, the number row types numbers and Fn plus a number sends F1 to F12. Direct: the top row sends F1 to F12 and Fn plus a key does the printed action; on 65%% and 60%% the number row sends F1 to F12 and Fn plus a number types the number.
